meals.name: Homemade Crispy Chicken Nuggets with Roasted Broccoli and Creamy Macaroni & Cheese
meals.description: Crispy baked chicken nuggets served with tender roasted broccoli florets and a rich, creamy stovetop macaroni and cheese. Total cook time: 45 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil and lightly grease. Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch pieces. In a shallow dish, combine panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. In another shallow dish, whisk eggs.

Step 2: Dip each chicken piece into the egg, then dredge in the panko mixture, pressing to coat thoroughly. Place coated nuggets on the prepared baking sheet. Toss broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a separate part of the baking sheet or a second sheet. Bake for 18-22 minutes, flipping nuggets halfway through, until chicken is cooked through (internal temperature 165°F/74°C) and broccoli is tender-crisp.

Step 3: While chicken and broccoli bake, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain well. In the same pot, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Whisk in 2 tablespoons flour and cook for 1 minute to create a roux. Gradually whisk in milk until smooth, bring to a simmer, and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.

Step 4: Reduce heat to low. Stir in shredded cheddar cheese, cream cheese, and Dijon mustard until melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add the cooked pasta to the cheese sauce and stir to combine. Serve crispy chicken nuggets, roasted broccoli, and creamy macaroni & cheese immediately.

meals.name: Quick Korean-Inspired Ground Beef & Kimchi Bowls
meals.description: A flavorful and quick ground beef and kimchi bowl served over steamed rice, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. Total cook time: 25 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Prepare the sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, gochujang, and sesame oil. Set aside.
Step 2: Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and no longer pink. Drain any excess grease.

Step 3: Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the prepared sauce and bring to a simmer, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes until the sauce slightly thickens and coats the beef.
Step 4: Divide cooked white rice among four bowls. Top with the Korean ground beef, a generous spoonful of kimchi, sliced scallions, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Tangy Pulled Chicken Sliders with Quick Pickled Red Onions
meals.description: Tender, tangy shredded chicken cooked in a slow cooker, served on slider buns with crisp, quick pickled red onions. Active cook time: 20 minutes; Slow cook time: 4-6 hours.
instructions: Step 1: Place chicken thighs in the slow cooker. In a bowl, whisk together chicken broth, apple cider vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Pour over the chicken.

Step 2: Cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours or on high for 2-3 hours, until the chicken is easily shredded with two forks. While chicken cooks, prepare quick pickled red onions: Thinly slice the red onion. In a small jar or bowl, combine white vinegar, 1/2 cup water, granulated sugar, and a pinch of salt. Stir until sugar dissolves. Add sliced red onion, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

Step 3: Once chicken is cooked, remove it from the slow cooker and shred it using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the slow cooker and stir it into the cooking liquid, ensuring it's well coated. Keep warm on the 'warm' setting.
Step 4: Toast slider buns if desired. Serve the tangy pulled chicken on slider buns, topped with a few slices of the quick pickled red onions. Offer any additional condiments as preferred.

meals.name: Skillet Pork & Pineapple Fried Rice
meals.description: A vibrant and flavorful fried rice dish with tender pork, sweet pineapple chunks, and colorful vegetables, all cooked in one skillet. Total cook time: 35 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Slice pork tenderloin into small, bite-sized pieces. In a bowl, toss the pork with 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, and cornstarch. Set aside to marinate for 10 minutes.

Step 2: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the marinated pork and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove pork from skillet and set aside.

Step 3: Add the remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil to the skillet. Add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add diced carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes until slightly tender. Stir in frozen peas and drained pineapple chunks, cooking for another 2 minutes.

Step 4: Push vegetables to one side of the skillet. Crack eggs into the empty side and scramble until cooked through. Add the day-old cooked rice to the skillet. Pour in the remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce and 2 teaspoons sesame oil. Stir everything together, breaking up any clumps of rice, and cook for 3-5 minutes, until rice is heated through and slightly crispy. Return cooked pork to the skillet and stir to combine. Garnish with sliced scallions and serve hot.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon-Herb Shrimp and Mediterranean Veggies
meals.description: Quick and easy sheet pan meal featuring succulent shrimp and colorful Mediterranean vegetables (zucchini, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes) seasoned with lemon and herbs. Total cook time: 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: large shrimp, peeled and deveined (tails on or off)

instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper or foil. In a large bowl, combine sliced zucchini, bell peppers, and cherry tomatoes. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil, half of the lemon juice, minced garlic, dried oregano, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Step 2: Spread the seasoned vegetables in a single layer on one half of the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 10 minutes.

Step 3: While vegetables roast, pat shrimp dry. Add shrimp to the same bowl you used for veggies (no need to clean). Drizzle shrimp with 1 tablespoon olive oil, the remaining lemon juice, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.

Step 4: After 10 minutes, remove the baking sheet from the oven. Add the seasoned shrimp to the other half of the baking sheet, spreading in a single layer. Return to the oven and roast for another 8-12 minutes, or until shrimp are pink and cooked through and vegetables are tender. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

meals.name: Hearty Baked Ziti with Meat Sauce and Mozzarella
meals.description: A classic Italian-American comfort food featuring baked ziti pasta layered with a rich ground beef and tomato sauce, ricotta, and plenty of melted mozzarella cheese. Total cook time: 70 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook ziti or penne pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside. In a large pot or Dutch oven, brown ground beef over medium-high heat. Drain excess fat. Add chopped yellow onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Step 2: Add crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, tomato paste, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, and pepper to the pot. Pour in beef broth. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and let it cook for at least 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, to allow flavors to meld.

Step 3: In a separate bowl, combine ricotta cheese with 1 cup of shredded mozzarella, 1/4 cup of grated Parmesan, 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, salt, and pepper. In a large baking dish (9x13 inch), spread a thin layer of meat sauce on the bottom. Add half of the cooked pasta, then dollop half of the ricotta mixture over the pasta, followed by half of the remaining meat sauce and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.

Step 4: Repeat the layers: remaining pasta, remaining ricotta mixture, remaining meat sauce, and top with the final 1 cup of mozzarella cheese and 1/4 cup Parmesan. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown. Let stand for 5-10 minutes before serving, garnished with remaining fresh parsley.

meals.name: Classic Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Creamy Mushroom Sauce and Mashed Potatoes
meals.description: Juicy pan-seared pork chops finished with a rich and creamy mushroom sauce, served alongside fluffy homemade mashed potatoes. Total cook time: 45 minutes.

ingredients.name: potatoes (Russet or Yukon Gold), peeled and quartered

instructions: Step 1: Pat pork chops dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear pork chops for 4-5 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through (internal temperature 145°F/63°C). Remove pork chops from skillet and set aside on a plate, tented with foil.

Step 2: While pork cooks, prepare mashed potatoes: Place peeled and quartered potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold, salted water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain well.

Step 3: To the same skillet used for pork, add a little more butter if needed. Add sliced mushrooms and diced onion. Cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, until mushrooms are browned and onions are softened. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Step 4: Pour in beef broth and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly reduced. Stir in heavy cream and Dijon mustard, simmer for another 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens. Return pork chops to the skillet to coat in sauce. For mashed potatoes, mash potatoes with 1/2 cup milk and 2 tablespoons butter, season with salt and pepper until creamy. Garnish pork chops with fresh parsley and serve with mashed potatoes.
